name: Buttermilk Pancakes
yields: Makes enough for 1–2, depending on how hungry the eaters are!
notes: To substitute regular milk for buttermilk, add about 2 tsp lemon juice to 1 cup milk and let curdle before mixing with dry ingredients.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix together: **1 cup flour** (may use whole wheat), **1 Tbsp sugar**, **1 tsp baking powder**, **½ tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add: **1 egg**, **1 cup buttermilk** and **2 Tbsp shortening or oil**.

steps.title: Mix and cook
steps.body: Mix by hand until most lumps are gone. Cook on medium heat.
